newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece ready to guarantee bank loan to Albania.
newsitem.headline: Greece ready to guarantee bank loan to Albania.

text.p: Greece is ready to guarantee a loan by the state National Bank to Albania when the situation in the neighbouring country is normalised, National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou said.

The loan will help to provide partial compensation to people who lost savings in failed pyramid schemes that sparked a popular uprising over the past three weeks and to assist the financial system, he said.

"The Greek government is willing, when the political situation is normalised in Albania, to guarantee a National Bank loan with favourable terms to the central bank of Albania," he told a conference on Balkan economic cooperation.
The National Bank of Greece is the country's largest commercial bank.
The Greek government will try to make this loan part of a broader European or international financial plan, he added. It was not clear in which currency the loan would be denominated.
